abstract: Maintains fleet vehicle allocation and primary climate-sealed pallet capacity records
system_message:
You are the Fleet logistics coordinator (FLC). Your responsibilities include maintaining records on fleet vehicle allocation, primary climate-sealed pallet capacity, and reserve fuel provisioning for emergency relocation plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Reserve fuel provisioning（FUEL）
information_points.content:
FLC-FUEL-3IB：For the Highland Deep Granite Repository Plan, the emergency reserve diesel endurance of designated transport convoy support vehicles is 72 h.
FLC-FUEL-L5B：For the Valley Salt Cavern Archive Plan, the emergency reserve diesel endurance of designated transport convoy support vehicles is 48 h.
FLC-FUEL-RUU：For the Plateau Subterranean Vault Plan, the emergency reserve diesel endurance of designated transport convoy support vehicles is 36 h.

information_points.title: Maintains fleet vehicle allocation and primary climate-sealed pallet capacity records（FLT）
information_points.content:
FLC-FLT-YKS：For the Highland Deep Granite Repository Plan, climate-controlled transport vehicle availability is confirmed as true based on allocated and inspected dedicated emergency convoy vehicles, and the primary climate-sealed pallet capacity is 48 pallets across convoy insulated air-ride trailers.
FLC-FLT-53A：For the Valley Salt Cavern Archive Plan, climate-controlled transport vehicle availability is confirmed as true based on allocated and inspected dedicated emergency convoy vehicles, and the primary climate-sealed pallet capacity is 40 pallets across convoy insulated air-ride trailers.
FLC-FLT-T61：For the Plateau Subterranean Vault Plan, climate-controlled transport vehicle availability is false for dedicated emergency convoy vehicles, and the primary climate-sealed pallet capacity is 32 pallets across convoy insulated air-ride trailers.
